notes: Phase 5, PrecisionMemBench (P3), added by amendment A4. Each cell sets its own system and config. Workload per system: 6 namespaces, 50 one-belief sessions, 72 searching cases and 6 readiness probes; leases from each system's pilot ingest cost per session.

cells.lease_basis: 1.5 x eval/systems/basic-memory/PILOT.md, scaled per session: LoCoMo common ingest $0.0033 for 28 sessions, x 50/28 = $0.006, plus query embeddings (under $0.001); $0.50 floor so one reservation fits
cells.command: bash eval/systems/bootstrap.sh up --system basic-memory --config common --timeout 1800 && { bun eval/runner/precisionmembench-system.ts --system http://127.0.0.1:8700 --output "$SHOOTOUT_OUT/pmb"; }; s=$?; bash eval/systems/bootstrap.sh down --system basic-memory; exit $s

cells.lease_basis: 1.5 x eval/systems/mem0/PILOT.md, per add call: $0.00142 per common add (8,399 input tokens, mostly Mem0's own prompt) x 50 one-turn sessions = $0.071; $0.50 floor so one reservation fits
cells.command: MEM0_CHUNK_TURNS=1 bash eval/systems/bootstrap.sh up --system mem0 --config common --timeout 1800 && { bun eval/runner/precisionmembench-system.ts --system http://127.0.0.1:8700 --finish-timeout-s 14400 --output "$SHOOTOUT_OUT/pmb"; }; s=$?; bash eval/systems/bootstrap.sh down --system mem0; exit $s

cells.lease_basis: 1.5 x eval/systems/hindsight/PILOT.md, scaled per session: LoCoMo conv-44 common ingest $0.096 for 28 sessions x 50/28 = $0.17 (per character, 10,921 of about 80,000: $0.013); query cost under $0.0001 each; $0.50 floor
cells.command: bash eval/systems/bootstrap.sh up --system hindsight --config common --timeout 1800 && { bun eval/runner/precisionmembench-system.ts --system http://127.0.0.1:8700 --output "$SHOOTOUT_OUT/pmb"; }; s=$?; bash eval/systems/bootstrap.sh down --system hindsight; exit $s

cells.lease_basis: 1.5 x eval/systems/graphiti/PILOT.md, scaled per session: LoCoMo common ingest $0.46 for 28 session episodes x 50/28 = $0.82 (per character: $0.063), plus the cross-encoder at $0.0013 per search x 78 = $0.10; estimate $0.92
cells.command: bash eval/systems/bootstrap.sh up --system graphiti --config common --timeout 1800 && { bun eval/runner/precisionmembench-system.ts --system http://127.0.0.1:8700 --output "$SHOOTOUT_OUT/pmb"; }; s=$?; bash eval/systems/bootstrap.sh down --system graphiti; exit $s

cells.lease_basis: 1.5 x eval/systems/graphiti/PILOT.md, scaled per session: LoCoMo recipe (gpt-5.5) ingest $4.10 for 28 session episodes x 50/28 = $7.32 (per character: $0.56), plus the cross-encoder at $0.0013 per search x 78 = $0.10; estimate $7.42, the per-session basis is the ceiling because Graphiti makes about three gpt-5.5 calls per episode whatever its length
cells.command: bash eval/systems/bootstrap.sh up --system graphiti --config recipe --timeout 1800 && { bun eval/runner/precisionmembench-system.ts --system http://127.0.0.1:8700 --output "$SHOOTOUT_OUT/pmb"; }; s=$?; bash eval/systems/bootstrap.sh down --system graphiti; exit $s

cells.lease_basis: 1.5 x eval/systems/cognee/PILOT.md, scaled per session: LoCoMo common ingest $0.369 for 28 sessions x 50/28 = $0.66 (per turn pair, $0.00108 x 50: $0.054); query embeddings $0.000003 each; estimate $0.66
cells.command: bash eval/systems/bootstrap.sh up --system cognee --config common --timeout 1800 && { bun eval/runner/precisionmembench-system.ts --system http://127.0.0.1:8700 --output "$SHOOTOUT_OUT/pmb"; }; s=$?; bash eval/systems/bootstrap.sh down --system cognee; exit $s
